พิมพ์ไทยไม่เป็น
component.summary: Type Thai and English with your voice
พิมพ์ไทยและอังกฤษด้วยเสียง

description.p: Turn Thai and English speech into editable text on your Linux desktop. Record with your microphone or open an audio file, then paste automatically after granting desktop permission, or review and copy the result.

On the first launch of a new installation, the app downloads Typhoon ASR Realtime separately, approximately 462 MB. Pause and resume the download in the app. Qwen models are optional downloads for English and mixed-language speech. Once the required models are installed, speech processing runs locally. Text and audio history are off by default.

New installations use Typhoon ASR Realtime with Smart Mix, automatic CPU selection and immediate paste. The app prepares recording and mode shortcuts and requests desktop consent for keyboard access. Existing user settings are preserved.
A penguin holding a microphone identifies the app. The interface follows light and dark mode with readable Thai typography. The icon contains no text.

ul.li: Edit, copy, retry, and translate Thai text into English
Select your microphone and test its input level
Download, verify, switch, remove, and import supported speech model folders
Inspect processing devices and compatibility information; GPU and NPU remain Beta features

description.p: Faster, more reliable dictation and a redesigned interface:

ul.li: The speech model stays loaded between dictations and is released after 5 idle minutes; it also starts loading while you speak
Downloaded models are integrity-checked, processing timeouts scale with audio length, and damaged settings are repaired with a backup
Paste works across Wayland apps through wl-copy, or copies the text and tells you when paste is unavailable
Duplicate Meta+H registrations are detected and cleaned up, and repeated key presses are debounced
The dictation popup shows preparing, input level, pasted, copied, queued and error states; you can record again while earlier speech is processed
Rotating log file and a copy problem report action for troubleshooting
Thai-first messages, new model cards, autosaving grouped settings with a shortcut recorder, a diagnostics checklist and a first-run wizard
Dark mode, better Thai typography, WCAG AA contrast and visible keyboard focus

description.p: Fixes startup crashes in Flatpak caused by mixed Qt platform plugins and stale singleton locks after a crash.
Improved recording, ASR job and paste lifecycle reliability, localized status feedback, display-aware window sizing, and regression coverage for popup and clipboard races.

A new text-free penguin microphone icon and a cobalt, amber and ivory glass interface. Automatic first-launch Qwen download, shortcut and paste consent setup, CPU defaults and GPU/NPU Beta warnings remain available. Existing settings are preserved.

Automatic first-launch Qwen model download with pause and resume, shortcut and paste consent setup, immediate paste for new installations, supported external model folder import, and clear GPU/NPU Beta warnings. Existing settings are preserved.
First downloadable Flatpak preview with Qwen3-ASR 0.6B as the default, Liquid Glass UI, a small left-side dictation popup, sound feedback, and Thai keyboard paste support.
